en.headline: Alliance leaders jailed for up to seven years three months
en.dek: A designated national security court sitting at West Kowloon sentenced Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho on Friday and fined the dissolved group HK$1.5 million.
body: A High Court panel sitting at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Friday sentenced three former leaders of the dissolved Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China over one count of inciting others to subvert state power. Chow Hang-tung received seven years and three months, former chairman Lee Cheuk-yan seven years, and former vice-chairman Albert Ho Chun-yan five years and two months. The Alliance itself was fined HK$1.5 million, to be paid within three months.

Ho pleaded guilty before the trial opened. The Alliance, Lee and Chow denied the charge and were convicted on 21 August after a trial without a jury before three designated judges under the Hong Kong National Security Law. The prosecution period ran from 1 July 2020 to 8 September 2021. Under the relevant provision, cases classed as serious carry imprisonment of not less than five years and not more than 10 years.

The court treated the case as falling in the serious category, citing what it described as premeditated conduct in a turbulent social atmosphere and a refusal to change course after the security law took effect. Judges said how to handle the Pillar of Shame sculpture would be decided on another date. Retired cardinal Joseph Zen and relatives of the defendants were among those who attended the hearing.

zh.headline: 支聯會案鄒幸彤判囚7年3個月 李卓人7年
zh.dek: 西九龍法院周五就煼動顛覆國家政權罪判刑，何俊仁囚5年2個月，已解散的支聯會罰款150萬元，須三個月內繳清。
body: 西九龍裁判法院（暫代高等法院）周五就已解散的香港市民支援愛國民主運動聯合會及其三名前領袖被控煼動他人顛覆國家政權罪判刑。前副主席鄒幸彤判囚7年3個月，前主席李卓人判囚7年，前副主席何俊仁判囚5年2個月。支聯會罰款150萬元，須於三個月內繳清。
何俊仁開審前認罪；支聯會、李卓人及鄒幸彤不認罪，今年8月21日經審訊後被裁定罪成。案件由三名國安法指定法官審理，不設陪審團，控罪指行為發生於2020年7月1日至2021年9月8日。按相關條文，屬情節嚴重者可判監5年以上、10年以下。
法庭界定本案為情節嚴重，指被告在社會氛圍動蕩下有預謀犯案，並在國安法實施後仍堅持原有立場。法官表示，「國殯之柱」如何處理將擇日再議。天主教香港教區榮休主教陳日君樞機及被告親友等到庭旁聽。
